note: The bands the Skyhunter plant has to land in, from docs/SKYHUNTER-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the X-UAV Skyhunter 1800. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

s1_level_65.source: level speed at 65 percent throttle, derived 18.80, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 5.5E curve (prop curves, scripts/skyhunter-derive.js), was 14.9 on the straight line; the band keeps its 12.8 percent under and 14.1 percent over, the room for the estimated inputs (was 13 to 17) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), and with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool), where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: derived 20.58, was 18.8; the same 0.872 to 1.141 of it.

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 9.2; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.10 / 5.52, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 5.141 (scripts/stall-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 5.52: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.19927536231884058. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.100 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.079, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.100 / 1.179) = 0.9661.

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 29.26, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 5.5E curve (prop curves, scripts/skyhunter-derive.js), was 23.5 on the straight line; the band keeps its 8.5 percent under and 12.8 percent over (was 21.5 to 26.5) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 29.53, was 29.26; the same 0.915 to 1.128 of it.

s5_roll.source: full aileron at about 20 m/s, derived 141; 69 percent is the throttle that holds 20 m/s level, 0.6893, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 5.5E curve (prop curves, scripts/skyhunter-derive.js), was 85 percent (0.8542) on the straight line, where 85 percent now holds 24.8 m/s Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick through the motor's law: the throttle that holds 20 m/s level is 0.6297, was 0.6893; the roll band at 20 m/s is the airframe's and stays.

s6_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

s7_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 12.44 at 16.5 m/s, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 5.5E curve (prop curves, scripts/skyhunter-derive.js), was 8.0 at 12.5 on the straight line; the band keeps its 31.2 percent under and 18.8 percent over (was 5.5 to 9.5) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 11.68 at 16.36 m/s, was 12.44 at 16.46; the same 0.687 to 1.187 of it.

s8_throw.source: a throw at 11 m/s, 60 percent, for two seconds the up stick that trims 11 m/s (2.9 deg of elevator); airborne and flying after three

s9_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

s10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model at 15 m/s built from the derivatives in docs/SKYHUNTER-STAGE1.md, derived 9.63, zeta 0.25 (Lanchester's 6.8 leaves out the pitch damping and the thrust's fall with speed), re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 5.5E curve (prop curves, scripts/skyhunter-derive.js): the curve's thrust falls more gently with speed, dT/du -0.517 against the line's -0.634 N s/m at the duty that holds 15 m/s, was 9.75 (9.8), zeta 0.29; the band keeps its 18.4 percent under and 17.3 percent over (was 8 to 11.5) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 9.62 (dT/du -0.506 N s/m at the duty that holds 15 m/s, 0.467), was 9.63 (-0.517 at 0.529); the same 0.816 to 1.173 of it.

s11_sideslip.source: full rudder, wings held level: -Cndr dr / Cnb, derived 13.7, the wind from the left

s12_yaw_rate.source: full rudder, ailerons centred: the Dutch roll step's peak rate, derived 68

s13_rudder_roll.source: full rudder, ailerons centred: bank after 2 s, the rudder's way, from dihedral; steady roll rate derived 22 deg/s

s14_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.29, measured electrical power 0.43 Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived the table's figures times the speed share squared the pack turns the prop at standing, 0.977^2 = 0.955 (the review's 15.5 V a fresh pack's, the gates' 4.1 V pack a little under it), was the table's; the same 0.250 to 0.450 of it.

s15_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and the wing's recorded flight hash in Node, both from before the Skyhunter existed; the Skyhunter must move neither Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build, on the owner's approval of the fix on 2026-09-26: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6). The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was.

s16_cross_host.source: the Skyhunter's scripted flight state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

stab_straight.source: thrown level at 12 m/s, 3 m up, 0.65 throttle, every stick centred in Stabilised: the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Stabilised's loops with ArduPilot's roll integrator: derived 3.36 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.008 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 3.36 m), the bank within 0.002 deg and the heading within 0.002 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.000 m of the derived -0.09. Held within 0.03 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 15 m off the line, a figure with no source. The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 18.74 m/s, the plant 18.73, within 0.016 along the curve, held within 0.05.

stab_straight_acro.source: thrown level at 12 m/s, 3 m up, 0.65 throttle, every stick centred in Acro (plant_wing.c acro_sticks: the attitude held where it was thrown): the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Acro's attitude hold: derived 1.16 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.003 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 1.16 m), the bank within 0.001 deg and the heading within 0.001 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.000 m of the derived 0.00. Held within 0.02 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 15 m off the line, a figure with no source. The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 19.87 m/s, the plant 19.86, within 0.015 along the curve, held within 0.05.
